description.en: Company and team OKRs that every team's agent keeps current with evidence: one light per key result, recovery actions, and a Monday business review — so the CEO asks one question instead of holding a status meeting.
description.zh-CN: 公司和各团队的 OKR 由各团队的 Agent 带着依据持续更新：每个关键结果一盏红绿灯、偏离就有补救行动、每周一自动出经营周报——老板问一句就知道进展，不用再开进度会。

agentPrompts: Which goals are at risk this quarter, and why?
Update the Growth team's key results from our data and flag anything that turned red.
